events.verdict: Duren's (DET) left hand slides off of the ball and onto Brown's (BOS) right arm while he is in possession of the ball.  Detroit is over the foul limit, and since a foul is correctly called on the play, Brown would have shot free throws regardless.
Duren (DET) grasps and releases Queta's (BOS) shorts as they pursue the rebound.
Hauser (BOS) contests Harris' (DET) jump shot attempt and the marginal contact with their arm after the release does not prevent them from following through.
Queta (BOS) firms up on his right foot in Harris' (DET) path prior to the contact.
Brown (BOS) loses his balance on his own and not as a result of any contact from Harris (DET) following the pick.
Harris (DET) moves alongside Brown's (BOS) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Cunningham (DET) briefly grasps, and immediately releases, Brown's (BOS) jersey off-ball.
Duren (DET) firms up over his right leg in Pritchard's (BOS) path prior to the contact.
Pritchard (BOS) legally contests Cunningham's (DET) jump shot attempt.
Brown (BOS) lifts and re-plants his pivot foot during his spin move at the start of his dribble.
Duren (DET) maintains verticality as he defends Brown's (BOS) shot attempt.
Pritchard (BOS) and Robinson (DET) mutually engage and disengage off-ball.
Brown (BOS) deflects the ball away from Cunningham (DET).
White (BOS) makes clean contact with the ball as he attempts to dislodge the ball from Cunningham (DET).
Queta (BOS) legally contests Harris' (DET) jump shot attempt.
Robinson (DET) deflects the ball away from Pritchard (BOS).
Brown (BOS) briefly grasps Duren's (DET) jersey as they engage for a potential rebound.
White (BOS) legally contests Cunningham's (DET) jump shot attempt.
After cleanly tipping the loose ball, Duren (DET) inadvertently steps on the back of Queta's (BOS) foot as he returns to the floor, which causes Queta to fall to the floor.
Thompson (DET) steps out of bounds and does not re-establish himself back inbounds before making contact with the ball.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Celtics.
Harris (DET) legally contests Brown's (BOS) jump shot attempt.
